name: Nord-Süd Weitwanderweg 05
description_md:
The Nord-Süd Weitwanderweg 05 is a 473.6 km waymarked hiking route located in Austria. The route is rated as hard, derived from distance and ascent.

It belongs to the national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as 05. It features 20291 m of ascent and 20906 m of descent. The walking time is about 173 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Additionally, the route passes Melk within 100 m.
